T-LOG 2026.08.10 [EN]

🌌 [2026-08-10 19:44]

[STATUS: SPOT]
The system noted a violent decomposition of support structures in the HVN zone; an intense exchange and breach of barriers occurred in the wide band 29770.0 – 29970.0. The NQ Probe is currently at the level of 29766.00, with ADR at 37.55%. The NDX Star shows an oversold state (CVD: -58,07M), while the QQQ Satellite confirms a demand test (CVD: -559,9K). The NQ Probe also shows a demand test (CVD: -4,28K). The wide TICKQ Exchange is in a state of market collapse (-200.00), which, with the SMA200 average at the level of 130.88 (market blast), generates a strong dissonance between micro-action and Background Radiation (TICKQ). The Q-Score vector is -18 (probability 41%), and the Oracle indicates low convergence in the short term (5m=7.0%). Average Action: [BRAK_DANYCH_W_TELEMETRII]. Volatility (IV) in the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) remains at the level of 20.39%.
